title: Scroll or Stay
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about the camera. The first is one room that fits the screen exactly, so the picture never moves. The second is a long walk, and the picture slides along after you. Whether a level scrolls is one switch on its scene, and the size of the level has to agree with it. Signs explain each idea, and every level has a page on how it is made.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has two short levels. In the first the picture stays still, because the whole room fits one screen. In the second it follows them down a long path. Signs say what each level shows, and the manual says how each is made.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Scrolling is a switch on each scene, and a level that stays must fit the screen
Made to be copied and taken apart
